The Science
What is Morpheus8?

Morpheus8 is a revolutionary FDA-approved treatment that combines microneedling with fractional radiofrequency (RF) energy to remodel and tighten skin from the inside out. It penetrates deeper than traditional microneedling â up to 8mm into subdermal tissue â targeting collagen, elastin, and even adipose fat for dramatic anti-aging results.

Morpheus8 uses 40 gold-coated microneedles to create controlled micro-injuries while simultaneously delivering RF energy deep into the dermis. This dual-action triggers your body's natural healing response â boosting collagen and elastin production for firmer, smoother, younger-looking skin.

Unlike surface-level treatments, Morpheus8 works at the subdermal level â creating a "shrink-wrap" effect that tightens loose skin, smooths texture, reduces acne scars, and minimizes wrinkles. It is safe for all skin types with minimal downtime, making it the gold standard in non-surgical skin rejuvenation.

Advanced Technology
How Does It Work?

Fractional Microneedling

40 ultra-thin gold-coated microneedles create controlled micro-injuries in the skin, triggering your body's natural wound-healing response. This stimulates massive production of new collagen and elastin â the proteins responsible for skin firmness and elasticity.

Bipolar RF Energy

Radiofrequency energy is delivered through the needles up to 8mm deep into subdermal tissue, heating and contracting collagen fibers. This creates an immediate skin-tightening "shrink-wrap" effect while remodeling adipose tissue for long-term contouring.

The Morpheus8 Process
1

Consultation & Numbing

Our dermatologist assesses your skin concerns and creates a personalized plan. A topical numbing cream is applied 30â45 minutes before treatment for maximum comfort.

2

Microneedling + RF Delivery

The Morpheus8 handpiece with 40 gold-coated needles is gently pressed into the skin, delivering RF energy at customized depths up to 8mm into the tissue.

3

Collagen Remodeling

RF heat contracts existing collagen fibers (immediate tightening) while micro-injuries trigger new collagen and elastin production over the following weeks and months.

4

Resume Your Day

Mild redness and swelling (like a sunburn) for 2â3 days. Results continue improving for up to 6 months as new collagen develops. Resume normal activities in 1â2 days.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Is Morpheus8 painful?

A topical numbing cream is applied before treatment, making it very comfortable. Most clients feel mild pressure and warmth during the procedure. Any discomfort is minimal and well-tolerated.

How soon will I see results?

You'll notice skin tightening within the first week as redness subsides. Collagen production continues for 3â6 months, with results progressively improving. Most clients see dramatic improvement after 2â3 sessions.

How long do results last?

Results last 1â2 years or longer, depending on your skin and lifestyle. Collagen remodeling is long-lasting, but natural aging continues. Annual maintenance sessions are recommended to preserve optimal results.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Morpheus8 pairs excellently with PRP, Botox, fillers, HydraFacial, and LED therapy. At ISAAC Luxe, our dermatologists often combine Morpheus8 with other treatments for comprehensive anti-aging plans.

How many sessions do I need?

Most patients achieve optimal results with 2â3 sessions spaced 4â6 weeks apart. For severe acne scars or significant skin laxity, additional sessions may be recommended. Maintenance is typically once a year.

Is there any downtime?

Minimal downtime of 1â3 days. Expect redness and mild swelling similar to a sunburn. Most clients return to work the next day. Avoid sun exposure and heavy makeup for a few days post-treatment.
